findings.current: 请在请求面板中回复这条敏感信息请求——在它得到答复前，此输入框暂停使用，草稿已保留。
findings.proposed: 在请求面板中回复这条敏感信息请求——在它得到回复前，此输入框暂停使用，草稿已保留。
findings.reason: zh-CN style guide, Formality & tone: '请' only where the English says 'please'; the English is a bare imperative. Sibling secret_ask_notice / secret_fill_* already use 请 for non-'please' source, so this is consistent with shipped copy; the notice is not a dialog. Drop 请 if the guide is applied strictly.
Same English word 'answered' rendered 回复 then 答复 in one sentence; the whole secret_* family uses 回复/填写. Optional unification (included in the Z2 wording).
录音 alone can read as sending the audio file; this faithfully mirrors the English 'Send recording' and the adjacent hint 转写并立即发送 disambiguates. No change required.
